t: Smith & Locke bungee set covers every tie-down job with one practical purchase. This 16-piece assorted kit includes four lengths—330mm, 450mm, 600mm and 1000mm—letting the user secure loads from small to large without hunting for the right size. Durable rubber and polyethylene construction resists weather, corrosion and abrasion, whilst PVC-coated steel hooks protect surfaces from marks. Each cord handles 8kg working load, making them suitable for securing tools, equipment and cargo during transport. Supplied in a storage tub for organised storage on site.
